title: RealNVP
core_mech: RealNVP 以三角 Jacobian 的 affine coupling 获得同时精确可逆、可采样且可算 log-likelihood 的映射。
core_mech_en: Constructs an exactly invertible normalizing flow using stacked affine coupling layers whose triangular Jacobians permit O(D) log-determinant and exact likelihood evaluation.
input_en: Continuous-valued image or feature vector x
output_desc: 潜变量 z、精确 log-likelihood，或由 z 反演生成的图像
output_en: Latent variable z = f(x), exact log-density log p_X(x), or exact inverse sample x = f^{-1}(z)

source.title: RealNVP
notes: Original Dinh TensorFlow implementation recovered at the parent of removal commit a8ba923c873f9848d0f6453f3e2e3fa2dd1187dc. Current default branch lacks research/real_nvp; keep this historical pin. Original code requires TensorFlow 1.x and legacy environment.

adapter.name: RealNVP
adapter.mechanism: Alternating affine coupling layers give exact inverse transforms and exact triangular-Jacobian log determinants.
limitations: Vectorized single-scale coupling, uniform dequantization, small MLPs; no original multiscale image architecture.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
